messages:
nora: opening a compact troubleshooting PR that collates 429s, timeouts, and context-limit fallbacks into one runbook. will include three tiny SDK cookbooks and a runnable sim harness. draft: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/5073 :spiral_note_pad:

ash: nice. for the harness let's do a tiny Flask service `/sim` with `?status=429&delay=200&burst=3`. add docker-compose so QA can run it locally. :whale:

pete: i'll add node + python snippets. patterns: parse `Retry-After`, retry-with-jitter, then fallback to trim or cheaper model. include short curl examples.

nora: add a one-paragraph UX blurb describing fallback order and user-visible effects (latency vs quality). two sentences max.

lint-bot: style: error-ref/combined-429.md line 12: use present-tense imperative. line 34: missing code fence language.

nora: thanks bot 12; i'll fix tense and add language markers.

ash: QA checklist suggestion: run `scripts/run-sim.sh --burst 5`, assert `Retry-After` present and metric `client.429.handled` increments. note: avoid fragile time-based assertions.

pete: ownership: nora (prose + PR), ash (harness), pete (snippets). landing target: PR today, tag @eng-qa for smoke tomorrow.

nora: perfect. i'll push the PR and ping reviewers when snippets are in.
